define.en: (1716-1771) an English poet, best known for his Elegy Written in a Country Church Yard. He was a friend of Horace Walpole. The few poems that he wrote had a strong influence on the development of the Romantic Movement.“Where ignorance is bliss'Tis folly to be wise.”Thomas Gray On a Distant Prospect of Eton College
